# Copilot instructions

- Remember we use Godot 4.6 inside VS Code with the godot-tools extension.
- Always check and fix Problem(s) before completing any changes.
- Only if asked to, review logic against the original VB6 code in the `vb6` folder in the root of this repo (parallel to the `godot` folder), unless specifically being asked to ignore it.
- The VB6 code is the original project and was source of truth. It should not be changed. The Godot project has now evolved beyond the VB6 project.
